verdictSummary: An /api/og endpoint with templates. This site generates its own OG images this exact way — at build time, for free.
name: Bannerbear (basic)
notes: An /api/og endpoint with templates. This site generates its own OG images this exact way — at build time, for free.

priorArt.name: satori
priorArt.desc: HTML/CSS to SVG — the engine to build on

prompt:
Build me an OG-image generation service like Bannerbear's basic tier. Requirements:

- A Node service with GET /og?title=...&subtitle=...&badge=... returning a
  1200×630 PNG, rendered with satori + @resvg/resvg-js (no headless browser).
- Templates are plain JSX-like functions in a templates/ folder — title, subtitle,
  brand color, logo slot. Ship two: a bold text-on-gradient one and a card-style
  one with a logo. Selecting: &template=card.
- Bundle one good open-license font (woff/ttf in the repo) so output is identical
  on any machine.
- Cache rendered images to disk keyed by a hash of the query params; serve cache
  hits directly with far-future cache headers.
- A / index page with a live playground form that previews the image and shows
  the copy-paste URL.
- Rate-limit by IP, cap title/subtitle length, and validate params. Deploy notes
  for a VPS behind a reverse proxy.
